description: Create Jetpack Compose UI architecture and theme system for Android (Mobile + TV). Set up MVVM architecture with Hilt DI, ViewModel structure, repository pattern, and navigation component. Implement Material 3 theme system with TV-optimized focus management and mobile touch-first design patterns.
title: Phase 2.1: Android Compose Architecture & Theme System
